scene: Inside the pavilion, glowing transport docks offer tickets out of the canal district.
picture: Inside a tea pavilion with silk canopies overhead. On the far left sits a parked yellow flying scooter. Left-centre, the silver-haired grandmother in pink tracksuit stands holding her white dog. Centre, a red double-decker hover bus floats beside a gate. Far right, a sleek silver hover metro train waits at its platform.
